answer: Ballots should follow a uniqueness census. This intake seals 21 POA in a shared vault and parks the applicant in a lagoon queue for one tidal cycle. Mid-queue, a camera records a live specular mirror of jitter, funding fan-in, and clock skew, committing spec = sha512(addr||jitter_root||fanin||skew||slot). Clerks admit the key only if that fingerprint is unique among queued occupants. Recording costs 0.39 POA; the bond unlocks after six epochs. Anyone can recompute it from the public packet tape. A later collision pays the vault to the first matcher and bars both keys for fourteen epochs.
